tooling_policy.rule: Repo-local tools under /tools/api551 are the default. Do not create new one-off active scripts in C:\GIT as the normal workflow.
tooling_policy.write_boundary: Toolkit write actions must not commit, push, merge, or delete branches. Git write operations require explicit user instruction.

lfs_policy.default: Do not run git lfs pull by default.
lfs_policy.ci: Structure check and API551 tooling check use lfs:false and pointer-safe checks.
lfs_policy.local_clone: Use GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1 for normal clone/sync work.
lfs_policy.download: Download LFS assets only by exact include path when needed.
lfs_policy.pointer_files: Small text LFS pointer files in local no-smudge checkout are expected and must not be treated as project corruption.
lfs_policy.hydrated_view: Keep the clean Git repo separate from local real PNG/PDF/ZIP review assets. Use C:\GIT\API551_HYDRATED_VIEW for hydrated visual review and recovery. Do not commit hydrated binary files as ordinary modifications.

local_lfs_hydrated_view_workflow.rule: Copy local binary files into a hydrated view only after matching source SHA-256 and byte size against the current branch LFS pointer oid sha256 and size.
local_lfs_hydrated_view_workflow.do_not_commit: Do not git add or commit hydrated PNG/PDF/ZIP files as ordinary Git modifications. Use the clean repo for branches and PRs.

repair_history.role: Operational evidence explaining why repo-local API551 tooling blocks stale overlays, accepted-status regressions, multi-root packages, LFS pointer confusion, PowerShell fragility, force-with-lease stale state, and docs/status drift.
repair_history.authority: History/evidence only; it does not replace CURRENT policy/rules.

acceptance_update_rule.description: Every accepted Figure candidate must update both Figure object files and project bootstrap/handoff/init files.
acceptance_update_rule.failure_condition: A Figure acceptance PR is incomplete if catalog/index accepted counts differ from handoff/bootstrap status or if handoff accepted_figures does not include the newly accepted Figure.

next_recommended_action: Run tools/api551 source-gate, choose the next not_accepted Figure from catalog.json, generate a rules-for report, and produce a review package without accepting it until explicit user approval.
